title: Initial configuration code characterization
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean input alphabet, let $x$ be a Boolean input word, and let $s$ be a natural number. A Boolean word $w$ satisfies the initial-check conditions for $N$, $x$, and $s$ if and only if it is exactly the configuration code of $N$'s initial configuration on $x$, using window parameter $s$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite nondeterministic Turing machine over Boolean symbols
